_about: Z26: zone silver-wing teleport item (menu, location save, portal cast and blast). Layouts read at the 2016 zone send sites; client handlers from the 2016 client.

0x301a.name: NC_ITEM_USECOMPLETE_CMD
0x301a.basis: zone ShinePlayer::so_SendProtocol(12, 0x1a) FUN_0054ef70 from smo_ply_ItemUse FUN_0053fd10 and sp_SilverWing_PortalBlast FUN_00597cf0; client ItemUseTask::OnProcessNetMsg FUN_006a2750
0x301a.notes: no payload (2-byte packet). Client: the first one while the item-use task is in state 3/4 records the use skill's cooldown (Skill::RecordSkillUse) and, in state 4, ends the cast bar; a flag ignores repeats (the silver wing sends it twice, Z26-B6)
